Voting holding capped at 19.99%; nonvoting stock has economic parity and converts on unaffiliated transfer, so governance caps do not eliminate economic dilution. Arrangement requires two-thirds of votes cast, court approval and other conditions; dissent requires exact timely perfection, not buying an automatic put. equities.catalyst: Asset-review campaign is substantive, but asset sales and capital returns are neither agreed nor guaranteed. Q2 CoreFFO$0.21;2026 guidance cut$0.85-$0.89 to$0.75-$0.79 owing to observatory NOI$55m vs prior$87-$92m. Underlying cash propertyNOI declined3.2% excluding$4m tax abatement. Positive17.8% lease spreads and94.9%leased/89.4%occupied support long-run improvement, offset by large tenant-improvement/leasing costs. FFO is not economic FCF. Verified $4.425 quote divided by management 2026 Core FFO $0.75-$0.79 = 5.60-5.90x, NOT P/FCF. Core FFO includes addbacks that overstate shareholder economic cash. Q2 $57.134m Core FFO reconciles to $16.152m Core FAD after $13.044m noncash rent adjustments, $24.720m second-generation TI, $2.676m building improvements and $11.435m leasing commissions, with $7.755m SBC added back. Four-quarter Core FAD totals $119.956m; subtracting $26.918m SBC gives $93.038m shareholder-economic proxy. At June 283.228m common shares/OP units and $4.425, equity proxy $1.2533bn gives 10.45x trailing cash FAD or 13.47x economic FAD. Neither is normalized forward FCF: tourist weakness and capex timing distort quarters. June debt approximately $2.2bn, cash $86m, net debt/adjusted EBITDA 6.6x; revolver availability is not cash value. Strategic asset review can unlock value, but low FFO multiple alone is insufficient for Buy.

equities.investment_thesis: Security identity: TASE security 1098755; exact symbol/class access not independently verified. Corrected Oct18 meeting disclosure 1776587 confirms the Sep16 services agreement with Eranovum e-mobility, ~49% held by controlling shareholder Keystone; correction cleans cross-references/formatting without changing substantive economics in 1776478. Fees for Spanish 137MW portfolio / 500MWh potential storage include €360k annual management, €0.5m portfolio financial-close success fee, €1m storage financial-close fee, €0.5m storage commercial-operation fee, plus €0.83m-€1.25m year-1 and year-2 return-gated success fees at 13%/15% EIRR tiers. La Guia adds €21.6k annual management rising to ~€90k at storage COD, €44k storage close and €22k COD fees, plus return-gated €22k/€33k success fees at 16.5%/17.4%. Proposed future JV is capped at 1,000MW/year (company share, ceiling only); Sunflower owns 90%-100% of SPVs with Eranovum option for 10% for pro-rata equity, and Sunflower may lend that share at the higher of project senior rate+2% or 10%, with 80% of Eranovum distributions swept to repayment. La Guia also has a 49% acquisition option for €0.9m plus a future €0.3m payment.

Ordinary profit includes69.564m dividends,101.646m equity-method profit and65.868m scrap income, offset by65.041m interest and34.137m derivative mark loss. Asset sales may reduce future dividends. Full-year guidance12200m sales, operating loss100m, ordinary profit60m, net2840m and EPS966.84JPY is dominated by securities/grant specials. Nominal1190/966.84=1.23x is not sustainable normalized forward P/E. August25 guidance, confirmed grant. ## Balance sheet and second arithmetic pass July31 cash1735.314m; short loans2150m,current long loans1100m,long loans4050m,total7300m; net debt5564.686m before leases. Investments4957.739m exceed reference market cap, but may include strategic/associated holdings and cannot all be assumed immediately realizable. July equity11500.146m implies0.304x dated book; securities valuation OCI reserve1824.945m shows material appreciation already carried in equity. Sale gain is not gross sale proceeds. Adding2056m gain atop marked securities or July book value double-counts existing value. Exact proceeds, taxes, remaining portfolio and debt application are unknown. Do not mechanically subtract sale gain from net debt. Q3 explicitly does not produce cash-flow statement. H1 CFO199.391m less PPE491.858m and intangibles52.038m gives simple FCF-344.505m. Because cash interest/dividends78.133m are investing and cash interest40.806m financing, including those yields diagnostic FCF-307.178m. Neither verifies forward FCF. H1 cash-flow statement. Second arithmetic independently checks net/gross share capitalization, gain ratio and FCF; all reconcile.
